svg.text: Layout A: one menu row, answer as a toast
Round 1, greyscale. Phone 412x915. The check runs on the host service (it already checks hourly and when Nod opens). Paired phones need the check route opened to them. Sample data synthetic.
One tap checks. No new screen. The answer is a toast over the list.
Check for updates sits last in the app-bar menu.
